description: This file contains classes and functions for integrating blivet-gui with the Anaconda installer, including GUI setup, event handling, error management, and interaction with storage configuration.

classes.name: BlivetUtilsAnaconda
classes.description: Utility class extending BlivetUtils with installer mode enabled and storage property.

classes.name: BlivetGUIAnacondaClient
classes.description: Client class to initialize and invoke methods on BlivetUtilsAnaconda.

classes.name: BlivetGUIAnaconda
classes.description: Main GUI class for blivet-gui integration with Anaconda installer, managing GUI components, event handling, and error dialogs.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the GUI, setting default filesystem type from remote call.

methods.name: ui_refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the UI, primarily setting cursor in device view.

methods.name: set_keyboard_shortcuts
methods.description: Configures keyboard shortcuts for the GUI.

methods.name: label_actions
methods.description: Property returning the label showing current actions.

methods.name: main_window
methods.description: Property returning the main window object.

methods.name: enlightbox
methods.description: Context manager to show/hide a lightbox overlay.

methods.name: _reraise_exception
methods.description: Handles exceptions, showing dialogs, and optionally raising or quitting.

methods.name: show_confirmation_dialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog and returns user response.

methods.name: run_dialog
methods.description: Runs a given dialog within the lightbox context.

methods.name: set_actions
methods.description: Sets the list of actions in the GUI.

methods.name: _handle_user_change
methods.description: Resets internal state when user changes something in the GUI.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads storage information and updates views.
